resources.string: Hold Volume Down for 0.8 seconds for rear video, or Volume Up for front video. Hold the same key again to stop. Short presses still adjust volume. Enable this service in Accessibility settings. Only key events are used; screen contents are not read. Video starts directly from the accessibility service without opening the app. Locked-screen support depends on the device.
Volume-key video shortcuts (Up: front / Down: rear)
Another recording or save operation is active. Finish it first.
Recording failed. Open Alibi and check camera, microphone and folder access.
Camera permission is required for the video shortcut.
Enable notification permission in shortcut settings to keep the recording indicator visible.
Shows a small red dot near the top edge during audio or video recording. Requires display-over-other-apps permission. The system status-bar icon is monochrome. Pause or stop removes the red dot.
No recording files in this category.
Recording is active. Fragment playback and sharing, and all deletion, are disabled until recording and saving finish.
File deletion failed. Check folder permissions.
No app could open this file, or access was denied.
This recording could not be played. It may be incomplete or use an unsupported codec.
The system did not allow background startup in time. Check background window permissions and hold the key again. This request has been cancelled.
Xiaomi / HyperOS may also require permission to display windows while running in the background. Allow it for Alibi to start video from the home screen.
Used for the next rear-camera recording and the Volume Down shortcut. Only cameras exposed by Android and CameraX are listed. Physical-lens video support also depends on the device.
Physical lens routed through its logical camera
Camera exposed directly by the system
Camera list unavailable. Check permission and refresh.
No selectable rear cameras. Grant camera permission and refresh.
Another recording is active. Hold the same volume key to stop it before switching cameras.
